title: 2 Timothy Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 2 Timothy 4: the charge to preach the word, itching ears and fables, the finished course, and the names of those who left and those who stayed.

questions.text: What is the first thing Timothy is commanded to do in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says to preach the word, to be urgent in season and out of season, and to reprove, rebuke and exhort with all patience and teaching.

questions.text: What will people with itching ears do when the time comes?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says that the time will come when they will not listen to sound doctrine, but having itching ears will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts.

questions.text: What will they turn away to when they turn their ears from the truth?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says they will turn away their ears from the truth and turn away to fables.

questions.text: What does the writer say has come, now that he is already being offered?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says that he is already being offered, and that the time of his departure has come.

questions.text: Along with fighting the good fight and finishing the course, what does he say he has done?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: "I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith."

questions.text: What is stored up for him, to be given by the righteous judge on that day?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says the crown of righteousness is stored up for him, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give him on that day, and also to all who have loved his appearing.

questions.text: Who left him, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says that Demas left him, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica.

questions.text: Who does the writer say is the only one with him?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says only Luke is with him, and asks Timothy to take Mark and bring him along, since he is useful for service.

questions.text: What is Timothy asked to bring from Troas, where it was left with Carpus?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 asks him to bring the cloak left at Troas with Carpus, and the books, especially the parchments.

questions.text: Who stood by him and strengthened him when everyone left him at his first defense?
questions.explanation: Verses 16 and 17 say that at his first defense no one came to help him and all left him, but the Lord stood by him and strengthened him.
